title: IELTS Speaking · Đề luyện tập NL-3
source: Đề tự soạn bởi NihongoLife theo định dạng IELTS Speaking (3 phần)

groups.heading: PART 1 · Introduction and interview
groups.instruction: The examiner asks about familiar topics. Answer each question in 2-4 sentences (up to 40 seconds).

items.text: Let's talk about travel. Do you prefer travelling by train or by bus?
How do you usually get to school or work?
Now let's talk about your free time. What do you like to do in the evening?
Is there a new hobby you would like to start? Why?

groups.heading: PART 2 · Long turn
groups.instruction: You have one minute to prepare (you may make notes), then speak for one to two minutes.
groups.stem: Describe a trip you would like to take in the future.

lines.text: where you would like to go
and explain why this trip is important to you.

items.text: Describe a trip you would like to take in the future.

groups.heading: PART 3 · Discussion
groups.instruction: Discuss more abstract ideas linked to Part 2. Give extended answers with reasons and examples (up to 75 seconds).

items.text: What are the advantages of travelling to another country to learn its language?
Should cities invest more in public transport than in roads? Why?
How can tourism help or harm a small town?
